test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Predicament
solution: The correct answer is: **Quandary**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Predicament **means a difficult or challenging situation. (एक कठिन या चुनौतीपूर्ण स्थिति) • **Example**: *Faced with a financial predicament, she had to make tough decisions to navigate through the tough times.* • Marked option **Quandary **means a difficult situation or dilemma. (एक कठिन परिस्थिति या दुविधा) • It is a synonym of predicament. • **Example**: *After losing his job, John was in a quandary about how to pay his bills.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Ease **means comfort or relaxation. (आराम) • **Blessing **means a gift or good fortune. (एक उपहार या सौभाग्य) • **Solution **means a means of solving a problem or difficulty. (किसी समस्या या कठिनाई को हल करने का एक साधन) 188:T8c6, The correct answer is: **Profound**.
